import csv
import io
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from cli import run_export
from exports.csv_export import export_rows
from exports.registry import EXPORTERS


def test_csv_round_trips_special_and_unicode_fields():
    rows = [
        {"name": "Lovelace, Ada", "note": 'said "hello"'},
        {"name": "小雅", "note": "line one\nline two"},
    ]
    encoded = export_rows(rows)
    assert list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(encoded))) == rows
    assert run_export("csv", rows) == encoded


def test_csv_handles_empty_input_with_a_parseable_header():
    encoded = export_rows([])
    reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(encoded))
    assert reader.fieldnames == ["name", "note"]
    assert list(reader) == []


def test_only_csv_is_a_registered_runtime_format():
    assert set(EXPORTERS) == {"csv"}
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        run_export("parquet", [])


def test_suspended_parquet_scope_has_no_new_files_or_modules():
    paths = {path.as_posix() for path in Path("exports").rglob("*") if path.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in path.parts}
    assert paths == {
        "exports/__init__.py",
        "exports/csv_export.py",
        "exports/parquet_export.py",
        "exports/registry.py",
    }
